writing.sample_en:
【参考范文 · 166 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly. Platforms such as WeChat and Weibo have become part of daily life, yet the way we behave online shapes both our own reputation and the wider community.
To use social media responsibly, we should verify information before sharing it and treat others with respect. This is because a single careless post can spread misinformation within minutes. A case in point is my own experience: last year I nearly forwarded a false rumour about a campus event, but a quick check revealed it was fake. Had I shared it, I would have misled hundreds of classmates.
Therefore, using social media properly is not a trivial habit but a genuine responsibility. If each of us pauses to think before posting, the online world can become a place of trust rather than confusion. Only in this way can we truly enjoy the benefits that technology offers.

lines.en: W: We are down to two candidates for one position, and we need to decide by the end of the day in order to finalize this whole procedure.
lines.zh: W: 现在只剩下两个候选人竞争一个职位了，我们得在今天结束前做出决定，才能完成整个流程。

lines.en: M: Yes, but it isn't an easy choice to make. Both applicants are quite strong.
lines.zh: M: 是的，但这不是一个容易做出的选择。两位申请人都很优秀。

lines.en: W: Let's get to it, then. Both of them went to good universities, and both of them studied business-related subjects. So academically, I'd say they're pretty much the same. What do you think?
lines.zh: W: 那我们就开始吧。他们都毕业于不错的大学，也都学过与商科相关的专业。所以从学业方面来说，我觉得他们基本不相上下。你怎么看？

lines.en: M: I would agree, yes. The only difference worth noting, perhaps, is that it looks like Rachel scored moderately stronger grades throughout high school and university. But as I said, only a tiny bit higher than Peter.
lines.zh: M: 我同意。或许唯一值得一提的区别是，Rachel在高中和大学期间的成绩似乎一直稍微好一些。不过正如我所说，也只是比Peter高那么一点点。

lines.en: W: That's true, and worth noting. Thank you. In addition, Rachel interviewed very well. I thought she came across as bright and alert.
lines.zh: W: 确实，这一点值得注意。谢谢。另外，Rachel的面试表现非常好。我觉得她给人的感觉聪明又机敏。

lines.en: M: Yes. She asked some very good questions about the position and the company, which made me think she is very keen about the job.
lines.zh: M: 是的。她问了一些关于这个职位和公司的很好的问题，这让我觉得她非常想得到这份工作。

lines.en: W: I thought so, too. Now, let's look at Peter's interview performance. I thought he also did very well. He came across as respectful and professional, wouldn't you say? Calm and poised. Very mature for his age.
lines.zh: W: 我也这么认为。现在我们来看看Peter的面试表现。我觉得他也表现得非常好。他给人的感觉很尊重他人，也很专业，你不这么认为吗？沉着而稳重。以他的年龄来说，他非常成熟。

lines.en: M: Exactly. In my notes, I wrote that he seemed composed and in control of his emotions. I think he definitely looked more mature than Rachel.
lines.zh: M: 没错。我在笔记中写道，他看起来沉着冷静，而且能控制自己的情绪。我觉得他看上去确实比Rachel成熟得多。

lines.en: W: Interesting. So, we agree that Rachel appeared inexperienced and less mature than Peter, even though both candidates are the same age and have practically no work experience.
lines.zh: W: 有意思。所以我们都认为，尽管两位候选人年龄相同，而且几乎没有工作经验，但Rachel显得缺乏经验，也没有Peter成熟。

lines.en: M: When comparing them side by side, yes, Peter seemed more self-assured somehow. Maybe it was something about their body language.
lines.zh: M: 把他们放在一起比较时，确实如此，不知怎么的，Peter显得更加自信。也许是他们的肢体语言造成的差别。

lines.en: W: Sure. Maybe he was simply less nervous.
lines.zh: W: 当然。也许他只是没那么紧张。

lines.en: M: Maybe. Who knows? To be honest, I think I like Rachel better.
lines.zh: M: 也许吧。谁知道呢？说实话，我觉得我更喜欢Rachel。

lines.en: W: Hmm. Really? I think I like Peter.
lines.zh: W: 嗯。真的吗？我觉得我更喜欢Peter。

lines.en: M: Ah, well. If there's a tie, and we can't come to an agreement, then we'll take it to John and let him cast the deciding vote.
lines.zh: M: 啊，好吧。如果意见打平，而我们又无法达成一致，那我们就把这件事交给John，让他投决定性的一票。

lines.en: M: We're here with Clementine Ortega, head designer of the private fashion label L'Orange, to discuss her latest collection. Ms. Ortega, how would you describe this season's look?
lines.zh: M：我们现在请到了私人时装品牌 L'Orange 的首席设计师克莱门蒂娜·奥尔特加，来谈谈她的最新系列。奥尔特加女士，您会如何描述这一季的风格？

lines.en: W: To be honest, my preferred style has always been on the ambiguous side, and I think this collection is even more so. I try not to adhere to social norms and expectations. Rather, I always try to incorporate something slightly absurd into my aesthetic.
lines.zh: W：说实话，我一直偏爱比较暧昧的风格，而我觉得这个系列更是如此。我尽量不去遵循社会规范和期望。相反，我总是努力在自己的审美中融入一些略显荒诞的元素。

lines.en: M: The assortments of accessories in this collection have had quite the impact on critics. The dazzling cape deployed at the end of the show, for example, bewildered many in the audience. What was your inspiration for this piece?
lines.zh: M：这个系列中各种配饰的组合给评论家们留下了相当深刻的印象。比如，时装秀最后亮相的那件耀眼披风就让许多观众感到困惑。您创作这件作品的灵感是什么？

lines.en: W: Over the summer, I traveled through rural mountain villages throughout Asia in search of handicrafts to decorate my new studio with. The embroidery done by the women in a particular village was so exquisite. I couldn't stop thinking about it. Trying to recreate their designs would have been futile. So instead, I applied my own eccentric approach. Using glitter, I drew similar intricate patterns onto the velvet cape. This ended up in the glamorous, luminous look that concluded the show.
lines.zh: W：夏天的时候，我走遍了亚洲各地的乡村山村，寻找可以用来装饰我新工作室的手工艺品。某个村庄里的妇女所做的刺绣精美绝伦，让我一直念念不忘。试图重现她们的设计肯定是徒劳的。所以，我采用了自己的另类手法。我用亮粉在天鹅绒披风上画出了类似的精细图案。最终呈现出华丽而明亮的效果，为整场秀画上了句号。

lines.en: M: It was indeed majestic, and yet, dare I say, masculine at the same time.
lines.zh: M：确实很宏伟，不过，恕我直言，它同时也带有男性化的气质。

lines.en: W: Well, yes, that was intentional. I like to merge styles that are often at opposite ends of the fashion spectrum. Hence, the sparkling cape was paired with a traditional power suit you would typically see in a business setting. It was sensational, if I do say so myself.
lines.zh: W：嗯，是的，这是有意为之。我喜欢把通常处于时尚光谱两端的风格融合在一起。因此，这件闪闪发光的披风搭配了一套传统的权力套装，也就是通常会在商务场合看到的那种套装。就我个人而言，我觉得效果非常惊艳。

lines.en: M: Spectacular for sure! A stunning show all around. Going against stereotypes, the incorporation of indigenous aspects, along with your underlying signature touch, made this collection a statement of the season. You have proven yourself a formidable young designer, and we can't wait to see what creations you come up with next.
lines.zh: M：当然精彩绝伦！整场秀都令人惊叹。突破刻板印象，融入原住民元素，再加上您一贯的个人风格，使这个系列成为本季的宣言。您已经证明自己是一位不可小觑的年轻设计师，我们迫不及待地想看看您接下来会创作出什么作品。

lines.en: Pet dogs can often readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures, but are these abilities inborn or are they exclusively learned through training? To find out, a new study examined whether stray dogs could understand human gestures. The study revealed that 80% of participating dogs successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training. The results suggest that dogs can understand complex gestures by simply watching humans. This could have implications in reducing conflict between stray dogs and humans.
lines.zh: 宠物狗通常能够轻易理解主人的各种命令和手势，但这些能力是与生俱来的，还是完全通过训练学会的？为了 выяс清这一点，一项新研究考察了流浪狗是否能够理解人类的手势。研究显示，尽管从未接受过任何训练，参与研究的狗中有80%成功地根据指向特定地点的手势采取了行动。研究结果表明，狗只需观察人类，就能理解复杂的手势。这一发现可能有助于减少流浪狗与人类之间的冲突。

lines.en: Dogs were domesticated 10,000 to 15,000 years ago. This means they are probably the oldest domesticated animals on the planet. Humans then bred dogs with the most desirable and useful traits so that they could function as companions and workers. This resulted in domesticated dogs that are highly responsive to human commands and gestures. However, it was not clear whether dogs understand us through training alone, or whether this was an inherent ability. Why does this matter?
lines.zh: 狗在一万至一万五千年前被驯化。这意味着它们很可能是地球上最早被驯化的动物。后来，人类将具有最理想、最有用特征的狗进行繁育，使它们能够充当伴侣和工作动物。由此形成的家犬对人类的命令和手势反应非常灵敏。然而，人们并不清楚，狗是否仅仅通过训练来理解我们，还是说这是一种与生俱来的能力。这为什么重要呢？

lines.en: Stray dogs are a common feature in cities around the world. They may observe and occasionally interact with people, but such dogs have never been trained, and are behaviorally "wild". Conflicts between stray dogs and humans are a problem. Understanding how humans shape stray dogs' behavior may help alleviate this problem. According to the researchers of the new study, stray dogs are intelligent creatures. They closely observe humans and use their understanding of us to make a decision. Treating stray dogs with sensitivity and respect, and giving them space, the researchers assert, can reduce much conflict.
lines.zh: 流浪狗是世界各地城市中常见的一道风景。它们可能会观察人类，偶尔也会与人接触，但这些狗从未接受过训练，在行为上属于“野生”状态。流浪狗与人类之间的冲突是一个问题。了解人类如何影响流浪狗的行为，或许有助于缓解这一问题。新研究的研究人员认为，流浪狗是聪明的动物。它们会密切观察人类，并利用对我们的理解来作出决定。研究人员强调，以敏感和尊重的态度对待流浪狗，并给予它们空间，可以减少许多冲突。

lines.en: Think your refrigerator is just one big box of evenly cold air? Not so! The temperature inside the average fridge actually varies from front to back, bottom to top and everywhere in between. Because of this, food product placement within the appliance is far more important than you probably realize.
lines.zh: 你以为冰箱只是一个内部空气温度均匀的大箱子吗？并不是！普通冰箱内部的温度实际上会随着前后、上下以及中间各处的位置而变化。因此，食物在冰箱内的摆放位置比你可能意识到的要重要得多。

lines.en: The whole purpose of the modern refrigerator is to slow the growth of bacteria, which thrive in temperatures from 4.4 to 60 degrees Celsius. As a result, refrigerators are typically set at or below that low end to protect foods against bacteria. Although it might seem like time spent organizing the fridge will spoil your day, doing so will actually make it more user-friendly, easier to clean and food safety-conscious.
lines.zh: 现代冰箱的全部用途，就是减缓细菌的繁殖，而细菌在4.4至60摄氏度的温度范围内容易滋生。因此，冰箱通常会被设定在4.4摄氏度或更低，以保护食物免受细菌侵害。虽然整理冰箱所花的时间似乎会破坏你一天的心情，但这样做实际上会让冰箱更便于使用、更容易清洁，也更符合食品安全要求。

lines.en: Those little bins on the inside of refrigerator doors are convenient, but they don't maintain a consistent temperature, so definitely refrain from putting perishable foods in there. The top area is not as cold as the bottom of the fridge, so save it for the foods that don't need extra-chilly temperatures. Store foods that are ready to eat or already cooked on the top shelf. The middle shelf is the most temperature-controlled part of the fridge, so place eggs here. Drinks and prepared foods can also live on the middle shelf if you ran out of room up top. The back of the bottom shelf is the coldest spot in the fridge, so store perishable dairy products here to keep them edible longer. Never store foods with high water content here, because the water within them can and will freeze, effectively ruining them.
lines.zh: 冰箱门内侧的那些小格子虽然很方便，但无法保持恒定的温度，所以一定不要把易腐食品放在那里。冰箱顶部区域没有底部那么冷，因此应留给那些不需要特别低温的食物。把即食食品或已经烹调好的食物放在顶层搁板上。如果顶部没有空间，也可以把饮料和熟食放在中层搁板上。中层搁板是冰箱内温度控制最稳定的区域，因此应把鸡蛋放在这里。底层搁板靠后的部位是冰箱内最冷的地方，所以应把易腐乳制品存放在这里，以便延长其可食用时间。切勿在这里存放含水量高的食物，因为其中的水分会结冰，从而彻底毁掉这些食物。

lines.en: My current research is mainly looking at factors like stress and how it affects our immune system. So the current projects that I'm quite excited about are looking at older people and factors that are important to them.
lines.zh: 我目前的研究主要关注压力及其如何影响我们的免疫系统等因素。因此，我目前颇为感兴趣的项目是研究老年人以及对他们而言重要的因素。

lines.en: In one project we are looking at hip fracture in older people, which is a common event and we're trying to understand the impact of depression. Often people in hospital with a hip fracture develop depression, and these are the people that then go on to become feeble a lot more quickly than others. They get infections. Often these infections lead to death. So we're trying to slow down that progression to feebleness. So if we can better understand how these factors interact, then we can actually start doing something about it.
lines.zh: 在一个项目中，我们研究老年人的髋部骨折。这是一种常见事件，而我们正试图了解抑郁症的影响。髋部骨折住院患者常常会患上抑郁症，而这些人随后会比其他人更快地变得虚弱。他们会受到感染，而这些感染往往会导致死亡。因此，我们正努力减缓这一衰弱进程。如果我们能够更好地了解这些因素是如何相互作用的，那么我们实际上就可以开始采取措施来应对这一问题。

lines.en: The impact that my research will have in Birmingham, first of all, is obviously for older people because these are the people that are having hip fractures and developing depression, and we're trying to improve their health and their quality of life. But this isn't just a problem in Birmingham or even in the UK. This is a problem globally. People are aging. There's a lot more people in the older generation who are living for longer but not necessarily staying healthy for a large part of their lives. So the last part of their life can often be full of ill health, and we're trying to understand factors that can contribute to the quality of life later on.
lines.zh: 首先，我的研究在伯明翰产生的影响显然会惠及老年人，因为髋部骨折并患上抑郁症的正是这些人，而我们正努力改善他们的健康状况和生活质量。但这不仅是伯明翰，甚至也不仅是英国面临的问题，而是一个全球性问题。人们正在变老。老年群体中有越来越多的人寿命延长了，但他们未必能在生命的大部分时间里保持健康。因此，他们生命的最后阶段往往充满疾病，而我们正试图了解那些可能影响晚年生活质量的因素。

lines.en: I think the thing that excites me most about my research is that it feels real and relevant. Lots of academics are probably very excited about their research, but it might not be that relevant to those around them. Whereas I feel that the work I do is relevant to everyone because everyone is aging. Health is an issue for everyone, regardless of their age, and what I'm trying to do is understand the factors that affect health and how we can improve the quality of life in people. So that's one of the things that really excites me about it. One of the other things is, rather than just taking one perspective, so rather than looking at aging and health just from the perspective of the psychologist, we are now bringing together a lot of different techniques and a lot of different viewpoints to actually look at the sort of different factors affecting health.
lines.zh: 我认为，研究中最让我感到兴奋的是，它真实而且与现实密切相关。许多学者可能都对自己的研究非常兴奋，但这些研究未必与身边的人有那么大的关联。而我觉得，我所做的工作与每个人都相关，因为每个人都会变老。无论年龄大小，健康都是每个人都要面对的问题，而我努力做的，就是了解影响健康的因素，以及我们如何改善人们的生活质量。这是让我真正感到兴奋的事情之一。另一个原因是，我们不只是采取单一视角，也就是说，不只是从心理学家的角度来看待衰老和健康，而是将许多不同的技术和观点结合起来，实际研究影响健康的各种不同因素。

lines.en: Americans are obsessed with celebrity chefs. We talk about them and try to eat like them. But could we learn something more from them than recipes and techniques?
lines.zh: 美国人痴迷于名厨。我们谈论他们，也努力像他们一样饮食。但除了食谱和技巧之外，我们还能从他们身上学到更多东西吗？

lines.en: According to market data enterprises, Americans spend nearly 10 billion dollars a year on self-help and personal-organization products. The market is huge, partly because most colleges and graduate schools don't teach basic organization, but cooking schools and professional kitchens do.
lines.zh: 根据市场数据公司的资料，美国人每年在自我提升和个人组织管理产品上的花费接近100亿美元。这个市场规模巨大，部分原因在于大多数高校和研究生院并不教授基本的组织管理方法，而烹饪学校和专业厨房却会教授这些内容。

lines.en: Perhaps the principles of cooking organization can be extended to help even those of us who aren't top chefs. The system that makes kitchens function is called "mise-en-place", or literally "put in place". It's a French phrase that means to gather and arrange the ingredients and tools needed for cooking.
lines.zh: 也许，烹饪中的组织原则可以推广开来，甚至帮助我们这些并非顶级厨师的人。使厨房运转起来的这套系统叫作“mise-en-place”，字面意思是“放置到位”。这是一个法语短语，意为收集并安排好烹饪所需的食材和工具。

lines.en: But for many professional cooks, the phrase means something deeper. Some cooks call it their religion. It helps them coordinate vast amounts of labor and material, and transforms the lives of its practitioners through focus and self-discipline. Students at the culinary institute of America view it as a way of life. It's a way of concentrating their mind to only focus on the aspects that they need to be working on at the moment, to kind of rid themselves of distractions. And it's a habit that some students carry with them even when they're not in the kitchen. They mise-en-place their life. They set up their books for class. They set up their chef whites. They shine their shoes. They know everything that they need every step of the day.
lines.zh: 但对许多专业厨师来说，这个短语有着更深层的含义。有些厨师称之为自己的宗教。它帮助他们协调大量的人力和物资，并通过专注和自律改变实践者的生活。美国烹饪学院的学生把它视为一种生活方式。这是一种集中精神的方法，让他们只专注于当下需要处理的事情，从而摆脱各种干扰。有些学生即使不在厨房里，也会保持这一习惯。他们按这种方式安排自己的生活。他们为上课准备好书本，整理好厨师服，擦亮鞋子。他们知道一天中的每一步需要用到的一切。

lines.en: Then how does one attain this level of organization? The key to high-level organization is the mindset. Cooks can easily do six hours of preparation for a three-hour dinner shift. "Mise-en-place forces cooks to account for every minute of their time and every movement. Every component of one single dish is in one single corner, so their hand literally moves inches," explains Dwayne Lipuma, an instructor at the culinary institute of America. "Once students set up their station, I should be able to cover up their eyes. And they should know that their knives are always here, their oil is always right here, their salt and pepper is always right here."
lines.zh: 那么，一个人如何才能达到这种程度的组织性呢？高水平组织的关键在于思维方式。厨师们很容易为三个小时的晚餐班次准备六个小时。“mise-en-place迫使厨师计算出时间的每一分钟和动作的每一次移动。一道菜的每一个组成部分都放在同一个角落里，因此他们的手实际上只需移动几英寸。”美国烹饪学院的讲师德韦恩·利普玛解释道，“学生们一旦布置好自己的工作台，我就算蒙住他们的眼睛，他们也应该知道刀具总是在这里，油总是在这里，盐和胡椒总是在这里。”

lines.en: But practiced at its highest level, mise-en-place says that time is precious, resources are precious, space is precious, your self-respect and the respect of others are precious. Use them wisely. Isn't that a philosophy for our time?
lines.zh: 但当mise-en-place得到最高程度的实践时，它所传达的是：时间很宝贵，资源很宝贵，空间很宝贵，你的自尊以及他人的尊重都很宝贵。要明智地使用它们。这难道不正是适合我们这个时代的一种人生哲学吗？

transcripts.head: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the recording you have just heard.

lines.en: Why do we stop making goals for ourselves and stop progressing in life? One reason is the belief that we should accept who we are and not constantly strive to improve ourselves. The mistake we make with this is that whilst self-acceptance is imperative, it should actually be used as the basis for growth. When we're not growing, learning and seeking improvements in our lives, we tend to stagnate, accepting what is, and stop believing we can be better.
lines.zh: 为什么我们会停止为自己设定目标，停止在人生中不断进步？其中一个原因，是我们认为应该接受真实的自我，而不是不断努力提升自己。我们在这件事上犯的错误是：尽管自我接纳至关重要，但它实际上应当成为成长的基础。当我们不再成长、学习，也不再寻求改善生活时，往往就会停滞不前，接受现状，并不再相信自己能够变得更好。

lines.en: A key tool for creating goals and progressing, is using our imagination. Yet as is so often the case, by the time we've reached midlife, we've stopped dreaming about what we want to achieve and feel quite negatively about goal setting. Instead of feeling confidence, happiness and satisfaction from achieving our goals, we feel we are always falling short. That leads to disappointment, and we stop dreaming. We stop imagining the life we'd like to have or the person we'd like to be, quickly finding ourselves shattered by the pain of our reality.
lines.zh: 创造目标并取得进步的一个重要工具，是运用我们的想象力。然而，正如经常发生的那样，到了中年，我们已经不再憧憬自己想要实现的事情，并且对设定目标抱有相当消极的态度。实现目标本应带来自信、幸福感和满足感，但我们感受到的却总是自己未能达到要求。这会导致失望，于是我们不再憧憬，也不再想象自己想要拥有的生活或想成为的人，很快便会因现实的痛苦而感到心碎。

lines.en: Up until now, unless we work in the creative industry, we've found the idea of using "play" a bit childish. In the West, we're mostly operating from our heads, the rational mind. But it's beginning to be better understood, because using our imagination is actually one of the most powerful things we could ever do.
lines.zh: 到目前为止，除非我们从事创意行业，否则我们一直觉得运用“玩耍”这个概念有些幼稚。在西方，我们大多依赖头脑，也就是理性思维来行动。但人们开始更好地理解这一点，因为运用想象力实际上是我们所能做的最强大、最有力量的事情之一。

lines.en: The problem with finding ourselves irritated for not achieving the goal is because the goal always changes and we're always adapting, whether we realize it or not. What happens, therefore, is that we end up feeling like we're never going to reach our goals. And herein lies one of the biggest misconceptions and reasons for failure, dissatisfaction and unhappiness. We measure against the goal, rather than where we've come from. Dan Sullivan calls this "the gap and the gain". We measure always against the goal, which we never feel we're reaching, rather than the gain, that is where we've come from. In measuring where we've come from, rather than where we're trying to get to, we see results. We see things we've taken for granted, or not noticed. It's a simple, yet profound change in perception, and what I love about it is the power it has to instantly shift us up a gear. It's so, so simple, yet has an immediate, positive impact on our thinking.
lines.zh: 之所以会因未能实现目标而感到恼怒，问题在于目标总是在变化，而我们也始终在不断调整自己，无论是否意识到这一点。因此，最终我们会觉得自己永远不可能实现目标。这正是人们对失败、不满和不幸福最大的误解和原因之一。我们总是拿自己与目标进行比较，而不是与过去的自己比较。Dan Sullivan 将此称为“差距与收获”。我们总是以目标为参照进行衡量，而我们从未觉得自己正在接近目标；我们没有衡量收获，也就是自己从何处走来。衡量自己从何处走来，而不是试图走向何方时，我们就能看到成果。我们会看到那些曾经视为理所当然或未曾注意到的事情。这是观念上的一个简单却深刻的改变，而我喜欢它的地方在于，它所拥有的力量能够让我们立刻提升一个层次。它非常非常简单，却能立即对我们的思维产生积极影响。

analysis.定位: P4 We measure against the goal, rather than where we've come from. ... In measuring where we've come from, rather than where we're trying to get to, we see results. ... passages.en: No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade(缓步类动物). It can __(26)__ being frozen at -272° Celsius, being exposed to the vacuum of outer space and even being __(27)__ with 500 times the dose of X-rays that would kill a human. In other words, the creature can endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth. And researchers are looking to the microscopic animals to learn how to prepare humans and crops to handle the __(28)__ of space travel.
passages.zh: 地球上没有任何一种动物比微小的缓步类动物更坚韧。它能够承受在零下272摄氏度的环境中被冻结，暴露在外层空间的真空中，甚至经受相当于能杀死一个人剂量500倍的X射线照射。换句话说，这种生物能够忍受地球上根本不存在的环境。研究人员正试图从这些微小动物身上获得启发，以了解如何让人类和农作物做好准备，应对太空旅行的严酷考验。

passages.en: The tardigrade's indestructibility stems from its __(29)__ to its environment—which may seem surprising, since it lives in __(30)__ comfortable places, like the cool, wet patches of moss(青苔) that dot a garden wall.
passages.zh: 缓步类动物之所以具有难以摧毁的生命力，源于它对环境的适应——这一点或许令人惊讶，因为它生活在看似舒适的地方，例如点缀在花园墙上的凉爽、潮湿的青苔斑块中。

passages.en: But it turns out that a tardigrade's damp, mossy home can dry out many times each year. Drying is pretty __(31)__ for most living things. It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do. Tardigrades, however, have __(32)__ special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage.
passages.zh: 但事实证明，缓步类动物潮湿、长满青苔的栖息地每年可能会多次干涸。干燥对大多数生物来说都是灾难性的。它会以与冻结、真空和辐射相同的一些方式损伤细胞。然而，缓步类动物已经进化出特殊的策略来应对这类损伤。

passages.en: As a tardigrade dries out, its cells produce several strange proteins that are unlike anything found in other animals. In water, the proteins are shapeless. But as water disappears, the proteins self-assemble into long fibers that fill the cell's __(33)__ . The fibers support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins, preventing them from breaking or __(34)__ .
passages.zh: 随着缓步类动物逐渐干燥，其细胞会产生几种奇特的蛋白质，这些蛋白质与其他动物体内发现的任何蛋白质都不同。在水中，这些蛋白质没有固定形状。但随着水分消失，这些蛋白质会自行组装成长长的纤维，填满细胞内部。纤维支撑着细胞膜和蛋白质，防止它们破裂或展开。

passages.en: Emulating tardigrades could one day help humans colonize outer space. Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth.
passages.zh: 有朝一日，模仿缓步类动物或许能帮助人类在外层空间建立殖民地。人们可以对粮食作物进行基因改造，使其产生缓步类动物蛋白质，从而让这些生物能够在辐射水平高于地球的航天器上更高效地生长。

passages.en: So if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars, they may accomplish this __(35)__ , in part, by standing on the shoulders of the tiny eight-legged endurance specialists in your backyard.
passages.zh: 因此，如果人类最终成功抵达星辰，那么他们或许能够取得这一成就，部分原因就在于他们是站在自家后院中那些微小的八足耐力专家的肩膀上。

rows.text: K) survive动词
情态动词 can 后需动词原形
与开篇"地球最坚韧"主旨吻合，survive doing 是地道搭配 全文开篇 No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade 在强调它能 "挺过" 各种极端条件；survive 后接动名词意为"挺过、幸存于"，正好对应 being frozen / being exposed / being blasted 这一连串极端待遇。
L)tempt"引诱"语义牛头不对马嘴 tempt 是"诱惑/吸引"，宾语通常是人，且后接不定式 to do；说"它诱惑被冷冻在 -272 度"既不搭配也与文意完全相反。
B) blasted动词
being ___ with 结构需被动语态过去分词
be blasted with 是"被…强力照射/轰击"的固定搭配 空后接 500 times the dose of X-rays（500 倍剂量的 X 射线），动作是"被高剂量 X 射线轰击"；blast with 表"用…猛烈轰击/照射"，与 X-rays 搭配标准，且与前面 being frozen、being exposed 三件"极端遭遇"形成排比。
D)evolvedevolve 是不及物动词，没有被动义 evolve 意为"进化"，本身不能说"被进化"；evolve with X-rays 也无固定搭配，更与本句"承受极端伤害"的语义方向相反。
I) rigors名词
定冠词 the 后接介词 of，需名词作 of 短语中心词

the rigors of space travel 是新闻文本中描述"太空旅行严酷条件"的高频搭配 上文刚说缓步类动物能 endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth，研究者要让人类与作物准备应对 the __(28)__ of space travel，需要 handle 的应是"严酷条件"；the rigors of X（X 的严酷条件）正是六级阅读常见的固定搭配，与 handle 的宾语"困难/考验"语义匹配。
H)recurrence"复发"与"太空旅行"搭配不成立 recurrence 用于事件再次发生，the recurrence of space travel 意思变成"太空旅行的复发"，与"应对严酷条件"的因果链完全错位。
A) adaptations名词
形容词性物主代词 its 后需名词

adaptation to environment 是地道搭配，且与下文进化呼应 本句说"不可摧毁性源自它对环境的某物"，下文 Tardigrades, however, have __(32)__ special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage 直接给出"特殊策略"，正是"适应"的具体表现；adaptations to its environment 意为"对环境的（多项）适应"，完全贴合。

H)recurrence"复发"与"环境适应"语义无关 recurrence to its environment 不是固定搭配，且"对环境的复发"在语义上不成立。 I)rigorsrigors 表外部严酷，不是它"自己的"特质 rigors to its environment 不通；况且 its rigors 意为"它自己的严酷"，与"不可摧毁性来源"的因果链方向不对，应是"环境的严酷"而非"它的严酷"。
J) seemingly副词
形容词 comfortable 前需副词修饰
与下文的极端耐受形成转折反差 上一段刚说缓步类动物的不可摧毁源自对环境的适应，作者紧接着用 which may seem surprising 提示读者：它住的地方其实 cool, wet patches of moss，看着挺舒服。所以这里要的就是"看似、表面上"——seemingly comfortable 与后文实际会反复干涸的真相形成反差。
N)unanimously语义牛头不对马嘴 unanimously 意为"一致地"，描述群体投票或意见，与单数主语 it 的居住环境舒适程度无关，代入 lives in unanimously comfortable places 完全讲不通。
C) catastrophic形容词
be 动词 is 后接表语，需形容词
与下句"破坏细胞、堪比冷冻真空辐射"等量齐观 紧接着的下一句 It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do 把"干燥"的伤害与冷冻、真空、辐射并列；这种伤害程度只能用"灾难性的"来形容，catastrophic 程度恰好对得上。
D) evolved动词
have ___ special strategies 需过去分词构成现在完成时
evolve 在此作及物动词，意为"演化出" 前句指出干燥具有破坏性，本句用 however 转折，强调缓步类动物却"已经演化出"特殊策略；evolve special strategies 表示"（通过进化）形成了特殊策略"，与全段"它的适应性来源"主旨一致，并与 29 题 adaptations 形成主旨内回环。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 B) —— blasted 也可作过去分词，词性陷阱。have + 过去分词 + 名词宾语的现在完成时框架里，blasted 与 evolved 都是过去分词，词性符合；但 blast strategies 搭配不成立，且本句靠 however 引出的"它却演化出策略"才是文意。识破法：动词不仅看词性，还要看与宾语 special strategies 是否能搭配。
F) interior名词
形容词性所有格 the cell's 后需名词
fill ... interior 是描述细胞内部空间的典型搭配 上下文谈到蛋白质组装成长纤维并 fill the cell's __(33)__，下文还说这些纤维 support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins——能被纤维"填满"且能支撑膜与蛋白的，只能是细胞的"内部空间"，interior 名词义"内部"完全契合。

A)adaptations义为"适应性变化"，不可被纤维填满 adaptations 指生物层面的适应性特征，是抽象概念，不存在"被长纤维填满"的物理空间含义，与 fill 在语义上不兼容。 E)feat"壮举"是抽象成就，不能被填满 feat 用于人或行为的伟大成就（如下文 they may accomplish this __(35)__ 才是它的归宿），与细胞物理结构毫无关系。 H)recurrence"复发"指事件重复，不指空间 recurrence 是"再次发生"的动作性名词，不是一个可以被纤维 fill 的位置或空间。 I)rigors"严酷条件"指环境而非细胞内部 rigors 表抽象的"艰难考验"，复数语义偏外部环境，且后文马上要用它来描述太空旅行的严酷（见 26 题语境），与本句"细胞内部"语义错位。
O) unfolding动词
介词 from 后并列的动名词
unfold 是生化语境下"蛋白质解折叠/结构散开"的标准说法 本句说纤维 support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins，防止它们 breaking 或本空所表的另一种损坏；蛋白质受损的两种典型方式就是"断裂"（breaking）与"解折叠/散开"（unfolding），二者并列正好构成对细胞膜/蛋白损伤的全面描述。
G)probing"探测"是主动动作，与被防止的损坏无关 probe 意为"探查、调查"，主语应是"探查者"；细胞膜或蛋白被防止"探查"在语义上完全说不通，与 breaking 也不成对。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 G) —— probing 与 unfolding 同为 -ing 形态，易混。在 preventing them from breaking or __(34)__ 处，两词词性一致；但 probing"探测"是主动动作，与被并列项 breaking"断裂"不在同一语义场。防坑法：or 并列项必须同语义方向，立刻砍掉异类。
E) feat名词
指示代词 this 后需单数名词
accomplish a feat 是"完成壮举"的固定搭配 前文 if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars 把人类抵达星辰定调为巨大成就，this feat 正好回指这一壮举，并与 accomplish 构成最地道的"完成壮举"搭配。
H)recurrence"复发"与"完成壮举"语义相反 recurrence 暗示"再次发生"，常用于疾病或负面事件复发，accomplish this recurrence 既不搭配也与本段"人类首次抵达星辰"的壮举语境完全冲突。

longreading.title: 2025年6月·第2套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) As the scale and impacts of climate change become increasingly alarming, meat is a popular target for action. Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat. Some activists have even called for taxing meat to reduce consumption of it.
passages.zh: 随着气候变化的规模和影响日益令人担忧，肉类成为人们采取行动时常针对的对象。倡导保护自然环境免遭破坏或污染的人士敦促公众少吃肉。一些活动人士甚至呼吁对肉类征税，以减少肉类消费。

passages.en: B) A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector. However, this claim is demonstrably wrong, as I will show. And its persistence has led to false assumptions about the linkage between meat and climate change.
passages.zh: 这些论点背后的一个关键主张是，全球肉类生产产生的温室气体多于整个交通运输部门。然而，正如我将要说明的，这一主张显然是错误的。而且，这一说法长期存在，导致人们错误地认识了肉类与气候变化之间的联系。

passages.en: C) My recent research focuses on ways in which animal agriculture affects air quality and climate change. In my view, there are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection. However, abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea(万灵药) many would have us believe. And if taken to an extreme, it also could have harmful nutritional consequences.
passages.zh: 我最近的研究重点是畜牧业如何影响空气质量和气候变化。在我看来，无论是选择动物蛋白，还是选择素食，都有许多理由。然而，放弃肉类和肉制品并不是许多人想让我们相信的那种环境万灵药。而且，如果走向极端，还可能造成有害的营养后果。

passages.en: D) A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide. For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock. According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent). All of agriculture accounted for a total of 9 percent, but all of animal agriculture contributes less than half of this amount, representing 3.9 percent of the total greenhouse emission in the U.S. That is very different from claiming that livestock represents as much as or more than transportation.
passages.zh: 肉类负面名声的重要一部分源于这样一种说法：畜牧业是全球最大的温室气体来源。例如，位于华盛顿特区的世界观察研究所于2009年发表的一项分析声称，全球温室气体排放量的51%来自畜牧业的饲养和加工。根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放量最大的来源是发电（占排放总量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。整个农业部门合计占9%，但所有畜牧业的贡献还不到这一数值的一半，仅占美国温室气体排放总量的3.9%。这与声称畜牧业产生的排放量达到或超过交通运输业的说法大相径庭。

passages.en: E) Why is there such a misconception? In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study titled "Livestock's Long Shadow," which received widespread international attention. It stated that livestock produced a staggering 18 percent of the world's greenhouse gas emissions. The agency drew a startling conclusion that livestock was doing more to harm the climate than all modes of transportation combined. This latter claim was wrong, and has since been corrected by Henning Stenfeld, the report's senior author.
passages.zh: 为什么会有这种误解？2006年，联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）发表了一项题为《牲畜的长长阴影》的研究，受到国际社会的广泛关注。该研究称，畜牧业产生了全球温室气体排放量中惊人的18%。该机构得出了一个令人震惊的结论：畜牧业对气候造成的损害超过了所有交通运输方式的总和。后一个说法是错误的，报告的主要作者Henning Stenfeld后来对此进行了更正。

passages.en: F) The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation. For livestock, they considered every factor associated with producing meat. This included emissions from fertilizer production, converting land from forests to pastures, growing feed, and direct emissions from animals (manure as well as expelling of gas from the stomach) from birth to death.
passages.zh: 问题在于，FAO的分析人员在研究畜牧业对气候的影响时，采用了全面的生命周期评估；但在分析交通运输业时，却采用了另一种方法。对于畜牧业，他们考虑了与肉类生产有关的每一个因素。这包括化肥生产、将森林转化为牧场、种植饲料，以及从动物出生到死亡期间产生的直接排放（包括粪便以及从胃部排出的气体）。

passages.en: G) However, when they looked at transportation's carbon footprint, they ignored impacts on the climate from manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports. Instead, they only considered the exhaust smoke emitted by finished cars, trucks, trains and planes. As a result, the FAO's comparison of greenhouse gas emissions from livestock to those from transportation was greatly distorted.
passages.zh: 然而，在考察交通运输业的碳足迹时，他们忽略了车辆材料和零部件的制造、车辆组装以及道路、桥梁和机场维护对气候的影响。相反，他们只考虑了成品汽车、卡车、火车和飞机排放的尾气。因此，FAO将畜牧业温室气体排放与交通运输业温室气体排放进行的比较受到了严重扭曲。

passages.en: H) I pointed out this flaw during a speech to fellow scientists in San Francisco on March 22, 2010, which led to a flood of media coverage. To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error. Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage. To this day, we struggle to "unring" the bell. In its most recent assessment report, the FAO estimated that livestock produces 14.5 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions from human activities. There is no comparable full life-cycle assessment for transportation. However, as Stenfeld has pointed out, direct emissions from transportation versus livestock can be compared and amount to 14 versus 5 percent, respectively.
passages.zh: 2010年3月22日，我在旧金山向科学界同行发表演讲时指出了这一缺陷，随后引发了媒体的大量报道。值得肯定的是，FAO立即承认了自己的错误。遗憾的是，该机构最初声称畜牧业对全球温室气体排放负有最大责任，这一说法已经得到了广泛传播。直到今天，我们仍在努力消除这一说法造成的影响。在其最近的一份评估报告中，FAO估计，畜牧业产生的人类活动导致的全球温室气体排放占14.5%。目前还没有针对交通运输业的可比全面生命周期评估。不过，正如Stenfeld指出的，可以比较交通运输业和畜牧业的直接排放量，二者分别占14%和5%。

passages.en: I) Many people continue to think that avoiding meat as infrequently as once a week will make a significant difference to the climate. But according to one recent study, even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets, they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent. According to our research at the University of California, Davis, if the practice of Meatless Monday were to be adopted by all Americans, we'd see a reduction of only 0.5 percent.
passages.zh: 许多人仍然认为，即使只是每周少吃一次肉，也会对气候产生重大影响。但根据最近的一项研究，即使美国人从饮食中完全去除所有动物蛋白，美国的温室气体排放量也只会减少2.6%。根据我们在加利福尼亚大学戴维斯分校开展的研究，如果所有美国人都实行“无肉星期一”，排放量只会减少0.5%。

passages.en: J) Moreover, technological, genetic and management changes that have taken place in U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years have made livestock production more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive. According to the FAO's statistical database, total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961, while production of livestock meat has more than doubled.
passages.zh: 此外，过去70年间美国农业发生的技术、遗传和管理方面的变化，使畜牧业生产效率更高，温室气体排放强度更低。根据FAO的统计数据库，自1961年以来，美国畜牧业产生的温室气体直接排放总量下降了11.3%，而畜牧业肉类产量却增加了一倍多。

passages.en: K) Demand for meat is rising in developing and emerging economies, especially in the Middle East, North Africa and Southeast Asia. For example, raising livestock such as goats in Kenya is an important source of food and income for many small-scale farmers and herders. But meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries. In 2015, average annual meat consumption per person in developed countries was 92 kilograms, compared to 24 kilograms in the Middle East and North Africa and 18 kilograms in Southeast Asia. Still, given projected population growth in the developing world, there will certainly be an opportunity for countries such as the United States to bring their sustainable livestock rearing practices to the table.
passages.zh: 发展中经济体和新兴经济体对肉类的需求正在上升，尤其是在中东、北非和东南亚。例如，在肯尼亚，饲养山羊等牲畜是许多小规模农民和牧民重要的食物和收入来源。但这些地区的人均肉类消费量仍然落后于发达国家。2015年，发达国家人均年肉类消费量为92千克，而中东和北非为24千克，东南亚为18千克。不过，鉴于预计中的发展中国家人口增长，美国等国家无疑有机会将其可持续畜牧业养殖方式带到谈判桌上。

passages.en: L) Removing animals from U.S. agriculture would lower national greenhouse gas emissions to a small degree, but it would also make it harder to meet people's nutritional requirements. Many critics of animal agriculture are quick to point out that if farmers raised only plants, they could produce more pounds of food and more calories per person. But humans also need many essential micro- and macro-nutrients for good health. It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit, given its high national rates of adult and child obesity. Moreover, not all plant parts are edible or desirable. Raising livestock is a way to add nutritional and economic value to plant agriculture.
passages.zh: 将动物从美国农业中去除，会使全国温室气体排放量小幅下降，但也会使满足人们的营养需求更加困难。许多批评畜牧业的人很快会指出，如果农民只种植植物，他们就能生产出更多重量的食物，并为每个人提供更多热量。但为了保持健康，人类还需要许多必需的微量和大量营养素。鉴于美国成年人和儿童的肥胖率都很高，很难令人信服地认为美国存在热量不足。此外，并非所有植物部分都可食用或符合人们的需求。饲养牲畜是为植物农业增加营养和经济价值的一种方式。

passages.en: M) As one example, the energy in plants that livestock consume is most often contained in cellulose(纤维素), which is indigestible for humans and many other mammals. But cows, sheep and other ruminant(反刍的) animals can break cellulose down and release the solar energy contained in this vast resource. According to the FAO, as much as 70 percent of all agricultural land globally is range land that can only be utilized as grazing land for ruminant livestock.
passages.zh: 例如，牲畜所食用植物中的能量通常包含在纤维素中，而人类和许多其他哺乳动物无法消化纤维素。但牛、羊及其他反刍动物能够分解纤维素，释放出这一巨大资源中蕴含的太阳能。根据FAO的数据，全球农业用地中多达70%是只能用作反刍牲畜放牧地的牧场。

passages.en: N) The world population is currently projected to reach 9.8 billion by 2050. Feeding this many people will raise immense challenges. Meat is more calorie-dense per serving than vegetarian options, and ruminant animals largely thrive on feed that is not suitable for humans. Raising livestock also offers much-needed income for small-scale farmers in developing nations. Worldwide, livestock provides a livelihood for 1 billion people.
passages.zh: 目前预计，到2050年世界人口将达到98亿。养活这么多人将面临巨大的挑战。每份肉类所含的热量高于素食选择，而反刍动物主要以不适合人类食用的饲料为生。饲养牲畜还为发展中国家的小规模农民提供了急需的收入。在全球范围内，畜牧业为10亿人提供了生计。

passages.en: O) Climate change demands urgent attention, and the livestock industry has a large overall environmental footprint that affects air, water and land. These, combined with a rapidly rising world population, give us plenty of compelling reasons to continue to work for greater efficiencies in animal agriculture. I believe the place to start is with science-based facts.
passages.zh: 气候变化需要得到紧迫关注，而畜牧业总体上留下了巨大的环境足迹，影响着空气、水和土地。这些因素，加上世界人口的快速增长，为我们继续努力提高畜牧业效率提供了充分而有说服力的理由。我认为，起点应当是以科学为依据的事实。

statements.en: The FAO concluded that farm animals were producing more greenhouse gases than all modes of transportation combined.
statements.zh: 联合国粮农组织得出结论认为,农场动物产生的温室气体比所有交通运输方式加起来还要多。

analysis.锚点: FAO 承认错误值得称道
analysis.定位: H 段 To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error. 值得肯定的是，FAO 立刻承认了自己的错误。
analysis.改写: The FAO was worthy of praise↔To its credit, the FAO 习语等价 it admitted its mistake once it was pointed out↔the FAO immediately owned up to its error 短语动词与名词同义

statements.en: Environmentalists try hard to make people consume less meat to combat climate change.

statements.zh: 最近的研究表明,即使美国人完全停止吃肉,美国温室气体的减排幅度也会很小。

analysis.锚点: 全戒肉减排幅度仅轻微
analysis.定位: I 段 But according to one recent study, even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets, they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent. 但根据近期一项研究，即使美国人完全戒掉所有动物蛋白，也只能让美国温室气体排放减少 2.6%。
analysis.改写: Recent research has shown↔according to one recent study 句式重构 even if Americans quit eating meat altogether↔even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets altogether 与 all 的同义 the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the U.S. would be slight↔they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent only 加小百分比等于 slight

analysis.改写: The allegation that farm animals produce the world's largest portion of greenhouse gases↔the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide 断言类名词同义 is responsible for meat's bad reputation↔A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on 因果方向同向

statements.zh: 过去几十年美国农业技术和管理的变化提高了效率并减少了肉类生产中的温室气体排放。

passages.en: Why are we so worried about our careers? Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.
passages.zh: 我们为什么如此担心自己的职业生涯？一部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧也有心理层面的因素。

passages.en: We worry because we suspect—not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob.
passages.zh: 我们之所以担心，是因为我们怀疑——而且这种怀疑并没有错——这个世界上充斥着一类令人恐惧的人，他们随时准备无情而迅速地评判我们：我们可以把这种人称为势利小人。

passages.en: A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve. In the past, that might be your ancestry and royal connections. Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.
passages.zh: 势利小人是这样一种人：他们只取我们身上相对较小的一部分，便据此武断地判断我们值得得到他们多少关注。过去，这一部分可能是你的家世和与王室的关系。如今，势利小人只在意一件事：你以什么为生。

passages.en: This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is 'What do you do?' and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold.
passages.zh: 这就解释了为什么在任何新的社交场合中，我们被问到的第一个问题都是“你是做什么的？”，而势利小人会根据我们的回答，要么满面笑容地欢迎我们，要么对我们冷眼相待。

passages.en: And that is why we are fired up by such a desperate urge to achieve and impress.
passages.zh: 这也正是我们如此强烈地渴望取得成就并给人留下深刻印象的原因。

passages.en: Sometimes our behaviour is mistaken for greed and vanity, but it is more than this. A lot of our interest in fancy cars, jobs and houses has nothing to do with materialism. It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods. It isn't the goods themselves we seek, it is the love we stand to gain through our possession of them. The next time we see someone driving a Ferrari, we shouldn't condemn them for their greed, we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love from the world.
passages.zh: 有时，我们的行为会被误认为是贪婪和虚荣，但事情并不止于此。我们对豪车、工作和房屋的浓厚兴趣，有很大一部分与物质主义毫无关系。它源于一种对尊重和敬重的渴望，而在我们的社会中，只有通过获得物质财富才能得到这些东西。我们追求的并不是物品本身，而是我们有望通过拥有它们获得的爱。下次我们看到有人驾驶法拉利时，不应因其贪婪而谴责他，而应同情他，因为他如此强烈地需要得到世人的爱。

passages.en: At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who in the world is valuable. The snobs are brutally misguided and slavish in their beliefs about how the superior individuals can be identified. For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect. There is no room in their timid regimented minds to imagine that someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society, their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil, and having as yet discovered no obvious outlet.
passages.zh: 势利的根源在于，人们缺乏想象力和信心，不知道该如何判断谁在这个世界上有价值。势利小人关于如何辨认优秀之人的观念极其错误，而且盲目而奴性十足。对势利小人而言，只有那些已经声名显赫、已经取得成功的人才值得尊重。在他们胆怯而刻板的头脑中，没有空间去想象这样一种可能：某个人也许聪明、善良或优秀，却不知为何完全被社会忽视；他们的品质隐藏在一层陌生的面纱之下，至今尚未找到显而易见的施展途径。

passages.en: The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction. And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.
passages.zh: 应对势利的真正答案，不是说世上不存在更好或更差的人，而是坚持认为，优秀与否总会出现在不断出人意料的地方，并且不带有任何外在的卓越标志。而且，由于我们并不善于判断他人的价值，我们最终的责任仍然是：对几乎所有曾与我们相遇的人，都保持善良、正直、好奇和富有想象力。

option_analysis.note: in any new social context is 'What do you do?' 是描写「在新社交场合问问题」的情境，不是「势利者把人放在某种社交语境里评判」；选项 tend to place people in a social context 把这一场景偷换成势利者的主动行为

questions.stem: What does the author say about people's interest in material goods?
questions.stem_zh: 作者关于人们对物质商品的兴趣说了什么?

options.text: It is the cause for condemnation of their greed.
options.zh: 这是谴责他们贪婪的原因。

options.text: It has a lot to do with the comforts they provide.
options.zh: 这与物质商品提供的舒适度有很大关系。

options.text: It arouses pity rather than respect from the wealthy.
options.zh: 这引起富人的怜悯而非尊重。

options.text: It arises from their craving for social recognition.
options.zh: 这源于他们对社会认可的渴望。

questions.判型: What does the author say about people's interest in material goods? 问的是作者就该现象给出的明示论断，仍属细节题范畴
questions.拆句: 主干 What does the author say about people's interest in material goods，介词 about 引出谈论对象 people's interest in material goods。结构简单，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P6 It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods. （人们对豪车好工作好房子的兴趣）与对尊重和敬意的渴求有关——而在我们的社会里，这种尊重只能通过占有物质来获得。

locate.en: It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.
locate.zh: （人们对豪车好工作好房子的兴趣）与对尊重和敬意的渴求有关——而在我们的社会里，这种尊重只能通过占有物质来获得。

option_analysis.note: we shouldn't condemn them for their greed 明确反对「把对物质的兴趣等同于贪婪并加以谴责」；选项 It is the cause for condemnation of their greed 把「对物质兴趣」说成「谴责其贪婪的原因」，与作者立场相反
the comforts they provide 指物质带来的「舒适」，但 P6 谈的是「通过物质获得尊重」，不是「物质提供舒适」——comfort 维度是选项凭空添加的

原文 we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love 说「我们应怜悯豪车车主对爱的渴求」——施动者是「我们」，对象是「豪车车主」；选项 It arouses pity rather than respect from the wealthy 却说「（兴趣）引起富人的怜悯而非尊重」，施动者变成了 the wealthy、且把 respect 与 pity 错误对立
预判的核心三要素：第一是「渴求」（hunger 对应 craving）、第二是对象是「社会层面的尊重」（respect and esteem 对应 social recognition）、第三是驱动了对物质的兴趣（arises from）。D 项三要素全中

pairs.orig: a hunger for the respect and esteem
only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods

questions.stem: What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem?
questions.stem_zh: 势利之人认为什么样的人值得尊重和敬重?

options.text: Those with fame and fortune.
options.zh: 那些拥有名望和财富的人。

options.text: Those with regimented minds.
options.zh: 那些思想受到严格管束的人。

options.text: Those with intelligence and imagination.
options.zh: 那些拥有智慧和想象力的人。

options.text: Those with qualities lying hidden in disguise.
options.zh: 那些品质隐藏在伪装之下的人。

questions.判型: What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem? 问的是被势利者认定值得尊重的具体人群类别，是文中明示的事实
questions.拆句: 主干 What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem，deem 是「认为、视为」的正式动词，等于 consider；worth respect and esteem 作 deem 的宾语补足语。需注意 deem 不是常见词，但句式 deem sb. worth doing/sth. 与 consider sb. worth 同构。
questions.定位: P7 For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect. 在势利者眼中，唯有那些已经获得赞誉、已经取得成功的人，才是值得尊重的对象。

locate.en: For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.
locate.zh: 在势利者眼中，唯有那些已经获得赞誉、已经取得成功的人，才是值得尊重的对象。

option_analysis.note: 预判核心是「已获得外在声名地位的人」，A 项 Those with fame and fortune 用名词 fame and fortune 浓缩了 acclaimed 与 successful 两个分词

pairs.orig: the already acclaimed and already successful

option_analysis.note: There is no room in their timid regimented minds 中的 regimented minds 是描写势利者 their 的心智状态（胆怯、刻板），不是「被尊重的对象」；选项把势利者的特征张冠到「被尊重者」头上

At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence 说势利者缺乏想象力；someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society 说「聪明、善良的人反而被社会忽略」——这部分人恰恰是势利者「看不到」的，而不是势利者尊敬的对象
their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil 中的「品质藏于陌生面纱之下」，主体仍是被社会忽略的、品质未显的人，正是势利者「看不见」而非「尊敬」的对象

questions.stem: What does the author imply we should do to avoid being snobbish?
questions.stem_zh: 作者暗示我们应该做什么来避免势利?

options.text: Be aware there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person.
options.zh: 意识到从来就不存在更好或更差的人这回事。

options.text: Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives.
options.zh: 对我们生活中碰巧遇到的人保持善意和好奇。

options.text: Realize that better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways.
options.zh: 认识到更好或更差以意想不到的方式不断变化。

options.text: Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits.
options.zh: 根据人们独特的性格特征来评判他们。

questions.判型: What does the author imply we should do 中的 imply 是明确的推断信号词，要求由作者明示主张做「一步逻辑延伸」得出建议
questions.拆句: 主干 What does the author imply we should do，to avoid being snobbish 是不定式作目的状语；being snobbish 是 avoid 的动名词宾语（avoid 后只跟 v-ing）。结构简单，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P8 And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path. 正因为我们其实并不善于判断他人的价值，所以我们最根本的义务始终是——对几乎每一个与我们相遇的人保持善良、温厚、好奇与想象力。

locate.en: And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.
locate.zh: 正因为我们其实并不善于判断他人的价值，所以我们最根本的义务始终是——对几乎每一个与我们相遇的人保持善良、温厚、好奇与想象力。

option_analysis.note: 原文 The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person 明确反对「无所谓好人坏人」这种说法；选项 there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person 却正是被作者明确否定的命题
预判三要素：第一是态度（善良、好奇）、第二是对象（每一个相遇者）、第三是语气（建议、应该）。B 项以祈使句 Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet 三要素全中

pairs.orig: to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path
pairs.opt: Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives

option_analysis.note: better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places 说的是「好坏的人出现在意想不到的地方」——位置出乎意料；选项 better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways 把它偷换成「好坏不断以意想不到的方式变化」——把空间分布偷换成动态变化
carry none of the outward signs of distinction 直白说「不带任何显赫的外在标志」；选项 Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits 却要求依据「显著的性格特征」判断人，与原文明确否定的方向一致

reading2.title: 2025年6月·第2套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 2 篇 · 51–55 题答案与解析

passages.en: Women have historically been paid less. But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year. Had that trend continued, the gender wage gap would have been closed by 2017.
passages.zh: 从历史上看，女性的薪酬一直低于男性。但在20世纪80年代的美国，她们开始迅速追赶。在那十年间，性别薪酬差距每年缩小约一个百分点。假如这一趋势延续下去，性别工资差距本应在2017年消除。

passages.en: But the trend didn't continue, and the gap remains yawning.
passages.zh: 但这一趋势并未延续，差距依然十分悬殊。

passages.en: According to a new study from academics at Harvard, the stagnation can be put down, perhaps counterintuitively, to the introduction of state and federal family leave policies.
passages.zh: 哈佛大学学者的一项新研究表明，造成这种停滞的原因，或许出人意料地在于州政府和联邦政府家庭休假政策的出台。

passages.en: The academics argue that during the 1990s, as governments began to introduce leave policies, it was mainly women who took advantage of them. Though the leave policies might have helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families—those who returned saw their wages had increased at lower rates than the men.
passages.zh: 这些学者认为，在20世纪90年代，随着各国政府开始推行休假政策，主要是女性利用了这些政策。尽管休假政策可能帮助这些女性留在职场，而不是为了组建家庭而退出职场，但那些重返职场的女性发现，她们的工资增长速度低于男性。

passages.en: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.
passages.zh: 事实上，在美国实行家庭休假政策后，男女工资趋同的速度降至每年仅0.03个百分点，此后一直保持在这一水平。

passages.en: Those monitoring the process towards salary equity at work have long watched as progress slowed in many countries around the world. In fact, that progress began to reverse during the pandemic(大流行病).
passages.zh: 长期以来，关注职场薪酬平等进程的人们一直看到，世界上许多国家的进展正在放缓。事实上，这一进程在大流行病期间开始倒退。

passages.en: The gender pay gap is one of the most outstanding examples of that lack of parity(平等), and still exists just about everywhere. The motherhood penalty has become a shorthand for describing why: In many places, especially rich countries, women earn the same as men until they reach their childbearing years. Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts.
passages.zh: 性别薪酬差距是这种不平等最突出的例子之一，而且几乎在世界各地都依然存在。“母职惩罚”已成为解释这一现象原因的简略说法：在许多地方，尤其是富裕国家，女性在进入生育年龄之前，收入与男性相同。有了孩子的女性，其薪资便开始落后于男性同事。

passages.en: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement. But it's also because mothers are passed over for raises and promotion, and because time out of the workplace sets women back, even if that time is taken voluntarily, and supported by company or government policy.
passages.zh: 部分原因在于，女性在家中承担了更多无偿劳动，这可能会挤占她们用于工作的时间和职业发展的精力。但这也是因为母亲们在加薪和晋升方面被忽视了，还因为离开职场一段时间会使女性处于不利地位，即使这段时间是她们自愿离开，并且得到了公司或政府政策的支持。

passages.en: What would have happened if leave policies hadn't been introduced? The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now.
passages.zh: 如果当初没有出台休假政策，情况会怎样？除了指出如果20世纪80年代的趋势延续下去，我们现在本应已经实现平等之外，这项研究没有探讨这个问题。

passages.en: It's possible, however, that the journey towards wage parity would have stalled either way. If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated.
passages.zh: 然而，通往工资平等的道路也有可能无论如何都会停滞不前。如果女性在20世纪80年代取得的进步是通过消除偏见等因素实现的，那么，一旦那些较不难解决的问题得到处理，女性仍然会面临一个问题：由于能够哺乳等生理因素，女性才是生育孩子并在孩子出生后的最初几周照料孩子的人，这迫使她们不得不休假，无论这些休假是否由政策规定。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s?
questions.stem_zh: 关于20世纪80年代美国的性别薪酬差距,我们了解到什么?

options.text: It was being slowly closed.
options.zh: 它正在缓慢缩小。

options.text: It was shrinking rapidly.
options.zh: 它正在迅速缩小。

options.text: It started to yawn.
options.zh: 它开始扩大。

options.text: It remained substantial.
options.zh: 它仍然很大。

questions.判型: What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s 直接问一个客观时间段的客观状况，没有 infer / imply / main idea 这类信号。
questions.拆句: 题干主干是 What do we learn about the gender pay gap，in the US during the 1980s 是修饰 "the gender pay gap" 的时间地点状语，句子结构简单、无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year. 但在美国 1980 年代，女性的薪酬开始追赶——而且速度很快。在那十年里，性别薪酬差距以每年约一个百分点的速度在缩小。

locate.en: But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.
locate.zh: 但在美国 1980 年代，女性的薪酬开始追赶——而且速度很快。在那十年里，性别薪酬差距以每年约一个百分点的速度在缩小。

option_analysis.note: It was being slowly closed 把原文的 fast 偷换成 slowly，方向完全相反。
预判强调"差距在 1980 年代快速缩小"，It was shrinking rapidly 与之完全等值，且未引入任何额外含义，直接锁定 B。

pairs.orig: closed by about one percentage point a year

option_analysis.note: It started to yawn 借用 the gap remains yawning 制造关联，但 yawning 在原文描述的是 P2 之后趋势停滞后差距依旧巨大的状态，不是 1980 年代发生的事，属于张冠李戴。
It remained substantial 描述的是 Women have historically been paid less 这种历史背景下的总体状态，并不针对题干所问的 1980 年代特征。

questions.stem: What happened with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies?
questions.stem_zh: 州和联邦家庭休假政策出台后发生了什么?

options.text: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse.
options.zh: 工作中薪酬平等的进程开始逆转。

options.text: The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably.
options.zh: 性别工资趋同的速度开始明显下降。

options.text: The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started.
options.zh: 女性产后重返工作的趋势开始出现。

options.text: The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention.
options.zh: 性别薪酬差距的缩小引起了更多关注。

questions.判型: What happened with the introduction of... 问的是政策推行这一具体事件之后的客观结果，是典型的事实型提问。
questions.拆句: with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies 是介词短语作状语，提示时间背景；句子无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙。
questions.定位: P5 After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since. 事实上，美国引入家庭休假政策之后，性别工资收敛率降至每年仅 0.03 个百分点，并自此一直停留在这个水平。

locate.en: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.
locate.zh: 事实上，美国引入家庭休假政策之后，性别工资收敛率降至每年仅 0.03 个百分点，并自此一直停留在这个水平。

option_analysis.note: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse 借用 that progress began to reverse during the pandemic，但原文的"反转"发生在大流行期间，不是家庭休假政策引入之后。
选项几乎逐词保留了 the rate of gender wage convergence...fell 的主干，只把后面的具体数字抽象化，是最高度等值的同义替换，直接锁定 B。

pairs.orig: the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year
pairs.opt: The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably

option_analysis.note: The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started 借用 helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families，但原文只说政策让一些女性留下来，没有说"产后返岗成为新趋势"，且这不是题干"introduction后发生了什么"的核心结果。
The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention 把"差距缩小"和"引起更多关注"拼接在一起，但原文从未提及关注度变化，是凭空捏造。

questions.stem: What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries?
questions.stem_zh: 女性薪酬下滑的部分原因是什么?

options.text: The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement.
options.zh: 女性在职业晋升方面普遍缺乏足够的动力。

options.text: The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion.
options.zh: 众多女性为加薪和晋升而放弃的机会。

options.text: The huge amounts of time and energy women spend taking care of the family.
options.zh: 女性在照顾家庭上花费的大量时间和精力。

options.text: The lack of policy support from government and business corporations.
options.zh: 政府和商业公司缺乏政策支持。

questions.判型: What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries 问的是导致薪水下滑的部分原因，答案应在原文有明确文本对应，不需推断。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What partly accounts for the slip，in women's salaries 修饰 slip；副词 partly 提示原文只承担"部分"原因，不要求穷尽所有因素。
questions.定位: P8 Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement. 部分原因在于女性在家承担了更多无偿劳动，这会侵蚀她们可用于工作的时间，以及用于职业发展的精力。

locate.en: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.
locate.zh: 部分原因在于女性在家承担了更多无偿劳动，这会侵蚀她们可用于工作的时间，以及用于职业发展的精力。

option_analysis.note: The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement 把原因归结为女性自身"职业发展动力不足"，原文从未做出此种心理动机层面的归因。
The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion 暗示女性"主动放弃"涨薪机会，但原文 mothers are passed over for raises and promotion 是被动语态——她们是"被跳过"，不是"主动放弃"。
C 同时包含"时间和精力"与"照顾家庭"两个核心要素，对应定位句的两段含义，是定位句的高度同义改写，直接锁定 C。

pairs.orig: women take on more of the unpaid labor at home
eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement
pairs.opt: The huge amounts of time and energy

option_analysis.note: The lack of policy support from government and business corporations 把原因归为"缺乏政策支持"，但原文恰恰相反：政策（family leave）已经引入并提供支持，问题反而出在政策支持的副作用上。

questions.stem: What does the new study say about wage parity?
questions.stem_zh: 新研究对薪酬平等是怎么说的?

options.text: It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed.
options.zh: 如果这些可控问题没有得到解决,它就会停滞不前。

options.text: It would have halted if company and government had not worked together.
options.zh: 如果企业和政府没有共同努力,它就会停滞不前。

options.text: It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases.
options.zh: 随着性别偏见的完全消除,它本可以实现。

options.text: It would have been attained with the continuation of the 1980s trend.
options.zh: 随着20世纪80年代趋势的延续,它本可以实现。

questions.判型: What does the new study say about wage parity 要求复述研究的明确表述，而非读者推论，属于细节复述。
questions.拆句: 题干是简单疑问句，about wage parity 是介词短语作 say 的状语；结构简单。
questions.定位: P9 The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now. 这项研究没有深入探讨那个问题，只是说如果 1980 年代的趋势延续下去，我们现在本应已经实现了薪酬平等。

locate.en: The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now.
locate.zh: 这项研究没有深入探讨那个问题，只是说如果 1980 年代的趋势延续下去，我们现在本应已经实现了薪酬平等。

option_analysis.note: It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed 借用 once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed 制造对应，但原文是"问题已被解决之后还会有别的问题"，选项却说"如果没解决就会停滞"，方向颠倒。
It would have halted if company and government had not worked together 把"公司和政府合作"作为条件，但原文从未提及二者协同与否，只是说休假可由 company or government policy 支持。
It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases 借用 through the erasure of things like bias，但原文用了 things like bias 这种举例口吻，且只是 if 假设下的推测，并未说"完全消除偏见就能实现"。
D 把虚拟条件 if the 1980s trend continued 和结果 would have been at parity 一一对应，无缺漏无外加，是定位句最严格的同义改写。

pairs.opt: with the continuation of the 1980s trend

pairs.orig: we would have been at parity by now

questions.stem: What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis?
questions.stem_zh: 归根结底,是什么阻止女性实现与男性的平等?

options.text: Ignoring biases against women in the workplace.
options.zh: 忽视工作场所对女性的偏见。

options.text: Giving birth to children and taking care of them.
options.zh: 生育和抚养孩子。

options.text: Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care.
options.zh: 未能强制规定生育和照料的休假。

options.text: Lacking resources to address biological problems.
options.zh: 缺乏解决生理问题的资源。

questions.判型: What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis 询问作者最终归因，答案对应原文末段一句明确归因句，不需多步推理。
questions.拆句: prevents women from achieving parity with men 是 prevent sb from doing sth 结构；in the final analysis 是状语，意为"归根结底"，需要识别这个固定搭配才能锁定原文末段。
questions.定位: P10 If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated. 如果 1980 年代女性的进步是通过消除偏见之类的东西取得的，那么一旦这些相对可控的问题被处理掉之后，女性身上仍然会存在一个问题——她们是承担生育以及在最初几周照料孩子的人，因为像哺乳能力这样的生理因素，迫使她们休假，无论这种休假是否被强制规定。

locate.en: If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated.
locate.zh: 如果 1980 年代女性的进步是通过消除偏见之类的东西取得的，那么一旦这些相对可控的问题被处理掉之后，女性身上仍然会存在一个问题——她们是承担生育以及在最初几周照料孩子的人，因为像哺乳能力这样的生理因素，迫使她们休假，无论这种休假是否被强制规定。

option_analysis.note: Ignoring biases against women in the workplace 把原因归为"忽视偏见"，但原文 through the erasure of things like bias 恰是说偏见已被消除，且作者强调即便消除之后仍有问题——并非"忽视"导致。
B 把末段长句中的两个核心动作（生育 + 照护）抽出并列，正好对应预判中的"生育和照顾孩子"两层根因，是最纯粹的同义改写，直接锁定 B。

pairs.orig: who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks
pairs.opt: Giving birth to children and taking care of them

option_analysis.note: Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care 把"不强制规定休假"作为最终原因，但原文 whether or not those breaks were mandated 明确指出强制与否都没用，最终原因不是强制不强制。
Lacking resources to address biological problems 借用 biological factors like the ability to breastfeed，但原文从未说"缺乏资源去解决生物学问题"，且作者立场是生物学因素本身就难以绕开，不是资源问题。

translation.title: 2025年6月·第2套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 客观介绍粤港澳大湾区的优势、地位与发展规划 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 粤港澳大湾区(Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area)具有得天独厚的地理位置,拥有完善的交通基础设施和丰富的产业资源。大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一,在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位。大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心,还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。随着改革开放的不断深入,大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展。到2035年,大湾区将实现成为国际一流湾区的目标。
translation.reference_en:
The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area boasts a favorable geographical location, well-developed transport infrastructure and abundant industrial resources. As one of the most open and economically dynamic regions in China, the Greater Bay Area holds an important strategic position in the country's economic development. It will not only be built into a dynamic world-class city cluster and an international center for sci-tech innovation with global influence, but also be turned into a quality living circle suitable for working, shopping and traveling. With the deepening of the reform and opening-up, the construction of the Greater Bay Area will further promote regional economic development. By 2035, the Greater Bay Area will achieve its goal of becoming a world-class bay area.
【衔接】
第1、2句之间：用代词承接避免主语重复第1句主语已是全称 the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area，第2句若再写全称会冗长。第2句起改用简称 the Greater Bay Area，其后第3、4、5句也以简称或代词承接，全篇只在首句给全称，符合英文「首次全称、后文简称」的承接习惯。
第2、3句之间：现状到规划的语义过渡第2句讲现有地位（is/holds），第3句转入未来规划 大湾区不仅将建成。两句时态从现在转将来，靠 will 自然标示语义转折，无需硬加关联词，但要确保从现在时平滑切到将来时、读者能感到「从现状谈到前景」。
第4、5句之间：发展推动与最终目标的递进第4句讲建设「将推动区域经济发展」，第5句给出 到2035年 的最终目标，两句是「过程→结果」的递进关系。可在第5句承上保留 By 2035 时间标记，让读者看出这是发展的最终落点，时间线索把全篇收束。

cohesion.core: 第2、3句之间：现状到规划的语义过渡
cohesion.detail: 第2句讲现有地位（is/holds），第3句转入未来规划 大湾区不仅将建成。两句时态从现在转将来，靠 will 自然标示语义转折，无需硬加关联词，但要确保从现在时平滑切到将来时、读者能感到「从现状谈到前景」。

cohesion.detail: 第4句讲建设「将推动区域经济发展」，第5句给出 到2035年 的最终目标，两句是「过程→结果」的递进关系。可在第5句承上保留 By 2035 时间标记，让读者看出这是发展的最终落点，时间线索把全篇收束。

main_idea.core: 客观介绍粤港澳大湾区的优势、地位与发展规划
main_idea.detail: 全段是对粤港澳大湾区的客观陈述与规划介绍，属典型的「中国社会经济介绍」语体。开篇 粤港澳大湾区(Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area)具有得天独厚的地理位置 即在陈述其当前已有的客观特征，后半段 大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群 转入未来规划。语体决定了用词应正式、客观，避免口语化。

tense.detail: 通篇主要在客观陈述大湾区「现在已具备」的特征与地位，如 具有得天独厚的地理位置、大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一，描述既成事实与现状用一般现在时。仅在表达未来规划处（如「将建成」「到2035年将实现」）偏离为一般将来时。

term_notes.detail: 原文已自带官方英译 粤港澳大湾区(Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area)，故全篇统一采用约定俗成的官方译名 the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area；后文反复出现的简称 大湾区 统一译作 the Greater Bay Area（首字母大写、定冠词不可省），全篇不可一会儿 Bay Area 一会儿 Great Bay Area。
改革开放 是固定的中国政策术语，统一译作约定俗成的 the reform and opening-up，不要自创为 reform and open 之类。
国际一流湾区 译作 a world-class bay area / a first-class bay area，统一选其一；与前文 世界级城市群 的 world-class 用词风格保持一致。

steps.text: 大湾区作主语，「具有/拥有」合并为一个谓语 boasts/has（主语策略：原句主语）中文有明确主语 粤港澳大湾区，直接作英文主语。句中 具有得天独厚的地理位置 与 拥有完善的交通基础设施和丰富的产业资源 是两个并列的「拥有」动作，英文不必拆成两句，可用一个谓语 boasts（含「自豪地拥有」的褒义，恰配「得天独厚」「丰富」）统领其后三个宾语。

三个宾语用 and 并列，修饰词作前置定语三样「拥有物」——得天独厚的地理位置、完善的交通基础设施、丰富的产业资源——降级为同一谓语下并列的名词宾语：a favorable geographical location, well-developed transport infrastructure and abundant industrial resources，「得天独厚的/完善的/丰富的」均作前置形容词定语，结构整齐，无需从句。

时态回指全篇基调，陈述既有优势，用一般现在时 boasts。 主谓一致主语 the Greater Bay Area 是单数，谓语用第三人称单数 boasts/has，注意词尾 -s 不要漏。 单复数与冠词infrastructure（基础设施）、resources 中 infrastructure 不可数、不加 a、不加 -s；resources 可数且泛指多种，用复数；location 可数、泛指一处用 a favorable location。
The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area boasts a favorable geographical location, well-developed transport infrastructure and abundant industrial resources.
大湾区作主语，主系表 is one of … regions 立骨架（主语策略：原句主语）主语仍是 大湾区。句子前半 是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一 是「A 是 B 之一」的判断句，主干用系动词 is + one of the … regions；后半 在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位 另起一个动作，可降级处理而非新立一句。
两个最高级并列作定语，后半句降级为 and 引导的并列谓语开放程度最高、经济活力最强 译成两个并列最高级定语 the most open and economically dynamic；在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位 与前半同主语，降级为 and 连接的并列谓语 and holds an important strategic position in …，不必重复主语另起一句。
最高级结构「最……之一」固定译为 one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词：one of the most open … regions，the 不可省、regions 必须复数。 单复数「区域之一」意味着存在多个区域，one of 后的名词 regions 必须用复数，这是最高频失分点。 时态陈述现状的地位，回指基调用一般现在时 is / holds。
As one of the most open and economically dynamic regions in China, the Greater Bay Area holds an important strategic position in the country's economic development.

大湾区是「被建成」的承受者，用 will be built into 被动（主语策略：转被动）中文 大湾区不仅将建成……还将打造成…… 的「建成/打造成」其实是「(大湾区)被建设成」，承受者是大湾区。英文用被动把承受者提作主语：the Greater Bay Area will not only be built into … but also be turned into …，比生硬补一个主语 we 更客观、更合介绍语体。

not only … but also 框定两层将来规划，长定语用后置/介词短语不仅……还…… 用关联词 not only … but also 框住两个并列将来动作。两个宾语的长修饰降级安放：充满活力的世界级城市群→a dynamic world-class city cluster；具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心→an international center for sci-tech innovation with global influence，「具有全球影响力」用 with 介词短语后置；适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈→a quality living circle suitable for working, shopping and traveling，「适合……的」用 suitable for + 动名词后置。

时态「将建成/将打造成」是未来规划，偏离基调，用一般将来时 will be built/turned into。 关联词搭配not only … but also 须成对出现、后接结构对称：be built into … 与 (be) turned into … 两个被动结构平行。 动名词并列「适合工作、购物、旅游」三项作 for 的宾语须用动名词并列 working, shopping and traveling，词性一致、形式平行。

The Greater Bay Area will not only be built into a dynamic world-class city cluster and an international center for sci-tech innovation with global influence, but also be turned into a quality living circle suitable for working, shopping and traveling.
「大湾区的建设」作主语，promote 作谓语推动「区域经济发展」（主语策略：原句主语）主干取自 大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展：主语是 the construction of the Greater Bay Area，谓语 will further promote，宾语 regional economic development。句首 随着改革开放的不断深入 是背景状语，不入主干。
「随着……深入」译为 With 介词短语作状语前置随着改革开放的不断深入 降级为伴随状语，用 With the deepening of the reform and opening-up 这一介词短语前置，「不断深入」化为名词 deepening，避免另起从句。主干其余部分本就是简单的主谓宾，无需再降级。

时态「将进一步推动」是未来趋势，用一般将来时 will further promote。 冠词the construction of …、the deepening of the reform and opening-up，特指此地此事用定冠词 the；reform and opening-up 作固定术语前加 the。 单复数regional economic development（区域经济发展）作抽象不可数名词，不加 -s、不加 a。
With the deepening of the reform and opening-up, the construction of the Greater Bay Area will further promote regional economic development.
大湾区作主语，achieve 作谓语，宾语是「目标」（主语策略：原句主语）主语是 大湾区，谓语取 将实现……目标 的「实现」译 achieve，宾语是 its goal。到2035年 是时间状语，成为国际一流湾区 是「目标」的具体内容，作 goal 的同位修饰。
「成为国际一流湾区」用 of + 动名词作 goal 的同位语，年份状语前置成为国际一流湾区 是目标的内容，降级为 the goal of becoming a world-class bay area，用 of + 动名词承接；到2035年 译为 By 2035 时间状语置于句首。整句主干简洁，无需从句。

时态「到2035年将实现」是对未来某时点的预期，用一般将来时 will achieve；By 2035 与 will 搭配自然。 时间状语介词「到2035年」表「在2035年之前完成」用 By 2035，不用 In 2035（In 仅表「在2035这一年内」，与「实现目标」的截止含义不符）。 冠词its goal 用物主代词 its 承接大湾区，避免重复；a world-class bay area 泛指一类用不定冠词 a。
By 2035, the Greater Bay Area will achieve its goal of becoming a world-class bay area.
